segments.title: Weekly round-up
segments.text: Hello, I'm Nova, the Ventryx AI presenter. This is your weekly market round-up for the week ending Friday 20 November.

segments.title: Markets this week
segments.text: Here's how the markets closed the week. The S&P 500 finished down 8.6 per cent. The tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 was down 10.4 per cent, and here in London the FTSE 100 ended down 5.1 per cent. Bitcoin was down 6.7 per cent over seven days.

segments.title: Biggest movers
segments.bar: Palo Alto Networks leads, Micron Technology lags
segments.text: Among the hundred big US stocks we track, the top riser was Palo Alto Networks, up 6.5 per cent, followed by Target and CrowdStrike. At the other end, Micron Technology fell 23.6 per cent, with NVIDIA and Marvell Technology also lower.

segments.title: In the headlines
segments.text: In the news on Palo Alto Networks, Stocktwits ran the headline: CrowdStrike-Zscaler Merger Could Make Cybersecurity Rival ‘More Formidable’ Against Palo Alto Networks, Says Jefferies.

segments.title: Momentum top 5
segments.text: On the Ventryx momentum list, this month's five are Micron Technology, Dell, Marvell Technology, Intel and Advanced Micro Devices. As things stand, 5 would drop out at the next swap. The next swap is on Monday 30 November.

segments.title: Crypto top 5
segments.text: In crypto, our experimental top five are NEAR Protocol, Zcash, Arbitrum, Uniswap and Monero, with Bitcoin 18 per cent below its two-hundred-day average.

segments.title: Next week
segments.text: Looking ahead to the week of Monday 23 November. It's a quieter week for big-company results. And on the prediction market Polymarket, the question "Will Bitcoin reach $62,500 in November?" is trading at about 52 per cent yes.
